{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOVRCof88AAAABZSfg5w", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4Bn7ElzhC5qWk", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4Bn7El", "number": 29, "title": "Implement 8237 terminal-count auto-init reload and preserve FDC completion", "body": "## Problem

DMA auto-initialization currently leaves the channel enabled without restoring its programmed transfer buffer. This prevents repeated guest-issued floppy commands from reusing a DMA buffer correctly.

At baseline `e75c1b848c955111f641cc7ed7611d588faa85fc`, [`Dma`](https://github.com/takahirox/pc98-rust/blob/e75c1b848c955111f641cc7ed7611d588faa85fc/src/devices.rs#L239-L325) has only current address/count registers. `advance()` wraps the count and sets terminal-count status, but auto-init merely suppresses masking. [`Bus::finish_fdc`](https://github.com/takahirox/pc98-rust/blob/e75c1b848c955111f641cc7ed7611d588faa85fc/src/bus.rs#L757-L800) identifies completion using `count[2] == 0xffff`; implementing reload alone would invalidate that test.

This is one bounded storage prerequisite. The supplied context lists no open Issue or recent improvement duplicating it.

## Expected outcome

Implement terminal-count auto-init for the four existing DMA channels and integrate its completion event with FDC READ/WRITE DATA on both VM and Ap profiles.

Hardware contract:

- Address/count byte writes update corresponding base and current bytes through the shared first/last flip-flop. Reads expose current registers.
- Each transfer increments or decrements the 16-bit address and decrements count. Count zero means one transfer; `0xffff` means 65,536. Terminal count occurs on decrement from zero.
- With mode bit 4 set, terminal count restores both current registers from their bases and leaves the mask unchanged. Otherwise, the final count is `0xffff` and the channel becomes masked. Terminal-count status latches in either case and clears on status read.

These semantics follow Intel’s [8237A datasheet, printed pp. 5–10: Single Transfer, Autoinitialize, register descriptions and Figure 7](https://read.seas.harvard.edu/~kohler/class/04f-aos/ref/hardware/8237A.pdf).

The FDC must consume the transfer’s terminal-count event independently of reloaded registers and previously latched status. NEC specifies that TC terminates DMA Read/Write transfers and completion enters the result phase with an interrupt; see the [µPD765A/µPD7265 datasheet, TC and Processor Interface sections](https://hxc2001.com/download/datasheet/floppy/thirdparty/FDC/NEC/upd765A.pdf).

Scope is internal terminal-count reload and its existing FDC consumer. External EOP injection, demand/block/single arbitration, software requests, verify transfers, memory-to-memory DMA, cascade/rotating priority, and broader FDC commands or timing remain separate work. Preserve the existing PC-98 bank-register mapping; this issue does not introduce address carry into a bank.

## Context and reproduction

The existing [`fdc_dma_read_write_seek_and_errors`](https://github.com/takahirox/pc98-rust/blob/e75c1b848c955111f641cc7ed7611d588faa85fc/tests/core.rs#L371-L435) exercises BIOS transfers. [`firmware::disk_transfer`](https://github.com/takahirox/pc98-rust/blob/e75c1b848c955111f641cc7ed7611d588faa85fc/src/firmware.rs#L80-L133) reprograms DMA for every request using non-auto-init modes, so it does not cover this defect.

A focused raw-port reproduction is:

1. Insert an original 1,261,568-byte HDM with differently patterned sectors on cylinder/head zero. Enable FDC motor/DMA using port `0x94 = 0x18`.
2. Clear the byte pointer at `0x19`; program channel 2 address `0x2000` through `0x09`, bank zero through `0x23`, count `0x03ff` through `0x0b`, mode `0x56` through `0x17`, and unmask using `0x15 = 2`.
3. Send `[0x46, 0, 0, 0, 1, 3, 2, 0x1b, 0xff]` through `0x92`; advance the existing scheduled completion and drain its seven result bytes.
4. Read back address/count after clearing the byte pointer. Current source leaves `0x2400/0xffff`; the required reload is `0x2000/0x03ff`. Issue another read without DMA reprogramming and verify reuse of the same buffer.

Findings are from source inspection; this read-only planning pass did not execute tests or change files.

## Pre-merge acceptance criteria

- [ ] Implement the contract above in original Rust, including an explicit transfer-completion indication usable after reload. FDC completion must not depend on a count sentinel or sticky status bit.
- [ ] Add original table-driven DMA tests covering all four channels, both address directions, auto-init enabled/disabled, counts `0`, `1`, `0x03ff`, and `0xffff`, address wrap, repeated service, byte-pointer sequencing, and byte reprogramming after partial progress. Assert intermediate readback, reload, mask/status behavior and channel isolation against independently calculated expectations.
- [ ] Add raw-port FDC tests for consecutive reads and consecutive writes with no DMA reprogramming between same-direction commands. Use distinct patterns and guard regions; assert exact transferred bytes, normal status (`ST0 & 0xc0 == 0`, `ST1 == ST2 == 0`), seven-byte result availability, completion IRQ and readiness for another command. Cover termination before EOT, a multi-sector DMA buffer, and a read ending within a sector. Retain terminal-count status between commands in at least one case to detect stale-event reuse.
- [ ] Build an original MIT NASM boot probe into a separate test-only HDM. It must exercise raw DMA/FDC ports, check repeated buffer reuse/readback, and expose deterministic pass/fail markers with bounded waits. Record source, license, assembly command, and source/image hashes. Run it through native `Machine` execution and the production Wasm core on both profiles and both browser serving paths. No proprietary firmware or guest software is required for this probe.
- [ ] Demonstrate that the new regression detects the baseline defect and passes with the implementation. Preserve established fixture bytes and existing game, DOS, device and persistence assertions.
- [ ] Run all fixture preparations and checks in [README’s reproduction instructions](https://github.com/takahirox/pc98-rust/blob/e75c1b848c955111f641cc7ed7611d588faa85fc/README.md#reproduce-the-checks), plus preparation of the new probe: `python3 tools/build_media.py --check`, `python3 tools/build_font.py --check`, `cargo test --locked`, `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo fmt --check`, `npm ci`, `npx playwright install chromium`, `npm test`, and `git diff --check`. Record exact results before merge.
- [ ] Update the DMA limitation in `docs/hardware.md` and record the bounded evidence. DMA remains partial: the excluded transfer/request modes and device interactions still require implementation or verification. Leave every other inventory category and its required scope intact. Passing these tests establishes this contract, not complete hardware accuracy or commercial compatibility.

## Optional validation

None.

## Required post-merge verification

None.
